I should also check if there are any other outcomes or subgroup analyses that might affect the data extraction, but since the focus is on HbA1c, I'll stick to that.

In summary, I'll structure the JSON with the study details, design, country, duration, and then the two arms with their respective data points. If any fields aren't present, I'll use "NR." I'll ensure all numerical values are copied exactly as they appear in the text.
